result.title: LiveVAE: Causal Window Attention Makes Efficient Streaming Video VAE
result.summary: While video diffusion models have grown faster and increasingly streamable, the video VAE remains a primary latency bottleneck across interactive generation and editing pipelines. Existing VAEs and their acceleration methods rely mainly on heavy convolutions or full frame attention, and most focus only on decoding, leaving encoding costly for streaming conditional generation and editing. This raises a natural question: Do video VAE encoding and decoding actually require such global spatiotemporal modeling? By analyzing the effective receptive fields of pretrained video VAEs, we find that both encoding and decoding a patch rely almost entirely on its spatial and temporal neighbors. To exploit this strong locality, we introduce LiveVAE, a streaming encoder and decoder built on causal window attention, which cuts per frame compute while keeping the temporal KV cache bounded for streaming. Decoupled encoder/decoder distillation followed by joint finetuning preserves the pretrained latent space, making LiveVAE a drop-in replacement for the original VAE. On MiniMax-H3, LiveVAE achieves 5.2-6.2x faster encoding and 3.0-3.3x faster decoding than the official VAE with higher PSNR. Paired with our dedicated inference infrastructure, LiveVAE pushes the speedup to 13.4x with almost no quality loss. Code and models will be released.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文分析预训练视频 VAE 的有效感受野，发现编解码主要依赖时空邻近区域，据此用 causal window attention 构建流式编码器与解码器，并通过解耦蒸馏加联合微调保持原 latent 空间，实现有界 KV cache 下的加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「单 patch 仅依赖局部时空邻居」的发现与有界 KV cache 的流式状态，可供核查 LVR 中视觉细节在 latent 内的可保留范围及长视频证据缓存的成本与截断策略，但本身不涉及推理过程。
